content: the maker's dated zone files: every box of its keep-out file, and those boxes of its keep-in file that contain positions of the on-board estimate of the flight (flights/flight_a/onboard_estimate.csv); its other keep-in boxes are left out
frame: the robot's own map frame (the frame of the on-board estimate, onboard_estimate.csv), metres
box_form: each box is [x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2]: two diagonally opposite corners of a box whose faces are parallel to the frame's axes
rule_as_documented: the maker's documentation: the union of all keep-in boxes minus the union of all keep-out boxes describes the free space in which safe flight can occur

keep_out.note: These keepouts reflect the occupation in the module.
